case.name: Concurso 36/2012
case.court: Juzgado de lo Mercantil nº 1 de Las Palmas
case.scope_warning: LPB's insolvency estate is not the whole mixed-ownership Sun Park complex. Do not infer title, possession or authority over Matkator or third-party property from an LPB insolvency act without asset-specific proof.

reading_rules: recognised insolvency credit != mortgage liability != competitive threshold != debt stated as consideration for the dacion != Registry value != possible surplus
two signed clarification Autos dated 26 January 2022 are located; the deed's separate 22 January recital is an internal notarial date inconsistency, not proof of a third judicial act
later deed or Registry implementation does not automatically cure an earlier authority, competition, credit-classification or non-convalidation issue
documentary difference alone does not prove nullity, fraud, bad faith, surplus or criminal responsibility

records.label: Signed order controlling the separate 2018 premises/pools disposal
records.safe_proposition: The controlled source bundle verifies the 2019 non-convalidation outcome, leaving the separate premises/pools and EUR 400,000 line as an autonomous implementation/accounting question.
open_bridge: bank and ledger treatment of EUR 400,000

records.label: Signed better-bid / interest reconstruction order
records.safe_proposition: The order explains the arithmetic route toward the mortgage-liability cap through subsequent accrual; it does not by itself establish final insolvency-credit classification.

records.label: Competitive notice / edict
records.safe_proposition: The notice separates mortgage components, the premises/pools amount and Community-fee component for the competitive threshold.
open_bridge: later legal function of each amount

records.label: Third-party acquisition proposal
records.safe_proposition: A concrete competitive proposal existed. Its existence alone does not establish admissibility, funding, entitlement to adjudication or improper rejection.

records.label: Auto 164/2021 — definitive approval of CAM proposal
records.safe_proposition: The complete signed five-page order definitively approves CAM's proposal after recording the third-party bidder's nonappearance and failure to lodge the bond. It does not prove every aspect of the third-party offer pack or later transaction performance.
open_bridge: complete third-party filed offer and authority/funds

records.label: First signed 15 October Auto — challenges to 18 May
records.safe_proposition: The complete five-page order dismisses LPB/Aweswell challenges and confirms the 18 May approval, describing the event as an improvement-of-offer process rather than a formal auction.

records.label: Second signed 15 October Auto — challenges to 12 May providencia
records.safe_proposition: The complete two-page order dismisses challenges as moot but uses auction/adjudication terminology later clarified by a separate 26 January order. Shared date does not make the two Autos one instrument.

records.label: 22 January date recited internally in deed 457
records.safe_proposition: One page of deed 457 contains a 22 January recital while another refers to 26 January. The two signed judicial originals located are both dated 26 January; the 22 January notation is preserved as a notarial reconciliation target, not modelled as a proved separate order.
open_bridge: certified docket confirmation that no distinct 22 January act exists

records.label: First signed 26 January clarification Auto
records.safe_proposition: The complete two-page order clarifies that the event was a better-offer licitation appearance, not an auction. It does not make the original approval, convey title, enlarge asset scope or calculate a surplus.

records.label: Second signed 26 January clarification Auto
records.safe_proposition: The complete three-page order clarifies and completes the other 15 October Auto and records that July 2021 ownership publicity was put before the court but considered irrelevant to realisation of the identified fincas. It is not a whole-hotel title finding or new adjudication.

records.label: Public deed no. 457
records.safe_proposition: The deed transfers the described mortgaged properties to CAM, states EUR 13,168,082.02 as debt serving as consideration for the dacion, requires communication to the Mercantile Court within five calendar days and contains cancellation requests.
open_bridge: legal-function bridge for the stated debt

records.label: Post-deed communication to Mercantile Court
records.safe_proposition: Deed 457 creates a specific downstream communication trace that should be independently verified.

records.label: Registry implementation and cancellations
records.safe_proposition: Later Registry implementation does not by itself establish the correctness of every upstream credit, authority, competitive or accounting proposition.

records.label: Liquidation accounts / residual closure
records.safe_proposition: No surplus or absence of surplus should be presumed from deed 457 alone.
